correctness.rationale: Cut representation K=1+sum Z_j, V=range-sum g_(2j) Z_j holds for every perfect matching. Internal matching probabilities q_(n,j)=C(n,j)/C(2n,2j) and nested-cut P(Z_i=Z_j=1)=q_(n,j)q_(j,i) imply strictly positive cut covariance because q_(a+1,b)/q_(a,b)<1. Conditional mixed covariance is negative for all positive gaps; independent location randomness preserves sign; IID uniform spacings give Cov(K,V)=-(b-a)Var(K)/(2n+1). Separate merged-interval exact rational enumeration of all matchings for n=2..5: counts 3,15,105,945 with strictly negative covariance (-10/9,-364/75,-13296/1225,-345356/19845) on unequal gaps. Proof handles all n>=2, n=1 zero.
residual_risks: Only covariance sign, not full negative association, and matchings must be uniform independent of atomless geometry with integrable range.
